params.caption: 🎮 Halo: Campaign Evolved is getting Firefight for free The Halo remake launched in July with no multiplayer modes at all, but that is about to change a little. Firefight, the 4-player co-op PvE survival mode, is coming to Halo: Campaign Evolved as a free update this winter. 🕒 Nov 12, 2026 · 20:52 (GMT+3) 📰 Sources: IGN · VGC 👥 @Xbox 🔥 React if you're jumping back in · 💬 Who's your Firefight squad? #Halo #HaloCampaignEvolved #Xbox #GamingNews
